profile.description: Mistral Small 3 is a pre-trained and instructed model catered to the ‘80%’ of generative AI tasks--those that require robust language and instruction following performance, with very low latency. Released under an Apache 2.0 license and comparable to Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct.
